description: Orders a managed database (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB or Valkey) in a private network, billed by the hour from now (the account needs 24 hours of credit), or by the month (730 hours) or the year (ten months) with billing; get_database_options gives each price. A monthly or yearly period comes out of credit if it covers it; otherwise billing.pending_invoice holds the invoice to pay and it stays hourly until then. Ready within minutes (status pending → active), with the admin user ffxfadmin and the logical database defaultdb (Valkey: the admin default, no logical database). Retrying the same call is safe. Scope: vms.create.

billing.description: hourly (default), monthly (the price of 730 hours, paid in advance) or yearly (ten months). Ask the user; monthly or yearly needs credit or an invoice paid by the user.

engine.description: Default postgresql. mysql is Percona Server; valkey is Redis-compatible (key-value, in memory).

idempotency_key.description: Your own unique value per order. By default one is derived from the call.

size_gb.description: Memory in GB, one of the sizes of get_database_options for the region. Default: 1, or the source's size.

version.description: Major version from get_database_options; the newest by default.

vpc.description: Private network the database joins (list_vpcs); the machines on it reach the database.

name: create_database
title: Create a database
